faqs.question: How do I book a servicing appointment?
faqs.answer: Log in to your owner account, pick a vehicle, choose the services you need, and select a date and time. You'll receive an instant confirmation and can track progress in real time.

faqs.question: Can I approve extra repair costs before you start?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the workshop finds additional repairs needed, you'll get a digital estimate. You can approve or reject it — no work happens without your approval.

faqs.question: How do I track my vehicle's repair progress?
faqs.answer: Follow your vehicle through the live status timeline: Received → Inspecting → Repairing → Testing → Ready. You can also chat with your service advisor anytime.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept card payments and cash at the counter. After payment you can download your invoice as a PDF from your service history.

faqs.question: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, all parts and labor are covered by a 12-month / 12,000-mile warranty on approved repairs.

faqs.question: How do I register a new vehicle?
faqs.answer: From your dashboard, go to My Vehicles → Add New Vehicle and enter the model, registration number, year, fuel type, and current mileage.
